messages:
Marta (recruiter): quick one — candidate Priya S. for L4 infra. competing offer arrives today. originally scoped at L4 mid base $150k. candidate asking for market match ~$168k. start window: late June. tracker ID O-2064-77. brief in drive: https://redwood.app/drive/priya_offer_note.pdf

Diego - People Ops: thanks Marta. >10% bump needs comp signoff; >15% needs committee. What exact numbers being requested (base, sign-on, eq)? Any relocation/visa?

Marta (recruiter): requested: base $168,000 (+12%), equity 0.8% 4y, sign-on $6k, remote US hire (no relocation). candidate flexible on start by 2 weeks.

Alex (ENG-Mgr): strongly support. Priya's micro-batching work would unblock two infra projects. happy to absorb run-rate if comp ok.

Nina (Comp): +12% is within manager flex if approved by comp. propose: approve +10% base ($165k) + $4k sign-on now, and $3k retention bonus at 6 months. equity unchanged. this keeps immediate offer competitive and runway friendly. i'll draft a short memo. @Diego loop finance for run-rate ack.

offers-bot: Offer tracker updated — O-2064-77 status: comp_review. https://redwood.app/offers/O-2064-77

Diego - People Ops: routing to comp-ops review. Finance (Sam) please confirm run-rate. Also note: since this is remote US hire, standard BG check and I-9 steps apply.

Nina (Comp): pasted memo snippet:
```
Candidate: Priya S. Role: L4 Infra Eng. Manager: Alex. Recommendation: Approve +10% base ($165k) + $4k sign-on (50% up front) + $3k retention at 6mo. Equity unchanged. FY27 run-rate delta: +$18k. Request: Comp team approval.
```

Diego - People Ops: Finance confirms run-rate ok. Approving at comp level. No committee needed. @Marta please extend offer at $165k + $4k sign-on; include clear 6mo retention clause.

Marta (recruiter): verbal accepted on that frame. candidate agrees to start 2026-06-22 provisionally. i'll post the formal packet link once generated. thanks all.

offers-bot: Offer packet created: https://redwood.app/offers/O-2064-77/packet — status: OFFER_SENT (2026-04-20 11:12:00 PT)

Diego - People Ops: I'll kick off onboarding checklist and BG check. Marking this thread resolved.
